```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Resolve paths from the Rmd file location (not current working directory).
# This keeps model/tool loading stable when render() is called from any directory.
resolve_plot_dir <- function() {
  input_path <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(), error = function(e) "")
  if (!is.null(input_path) && nzchar(input_path)) {
    # current_input() returns the input file path during knitting.
    return(normalizePath(dirname(input_path), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  }
  normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}

PLOT_DIR <- resolve_plot_dir()
source(file.path(PLOT_DIR, "..", "tools", "plot_utils.R"))
source(file.path(PLOT_DIR, "R", "load_plot_modules.R"))
load_plot_modules(PLOT_DIR)

# Paths
resolve_model_dir <- function(plot_dir = PLOT_DIR) {
  env_dir <- Sys.getenv("PLOT_MODEL_DIR", "")
  if (nzchar(env_dir) && dir.exists(env_dir)) {
    return(normalizePath(env_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  }

  last_dir_files <- c(
    file.path(plot_dir, ".model_dir_last.rds"),
    file.path(plot_dir, "..", ".model_dir_last.rds")
  )
  for (f in last_dir_files) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
      last_dir <- tryCatch(readRDS(f), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(last_dir) && nzchar(last_dir) && dir.exists(last_dir)) {
        return(normalizePath(last_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
      }
    }
  }

  default_dir <- file.path(plot_dir, "..", "model")
  normalizePath(default_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
MODEL_DIR <- resolve_model_dir(PLOT_DIR)

#' Safely read a file, returning NULL if it doesn't exist
#' @param path File path to read
#' @param reader Function to use for reading (e.g., readLines, read.MFCLPar)
safe_read <- function(path, reader = readLines) {
  if (file.exists(path)) reader(path) else NULL
}

#' Get scenario names that have profiling enabled
#' If run_prof is not in info_list, check if prof_lik_list has data
get_prof_scenarios <- function(info_list, prof_lik_list) {
  # Shiny behavior: rely on actual profile outputs, not run_prof metadata.
  names(prof_lik_list)
}

get_profile_context <- function(info_list, prof_lik_list, prof_lik_raw_list = NULL) {
  scenarios <- get_prof_scenarios(info_list, prof_lik_list)
  scenarios <- intersect(scenarios, names(prof_lik_list))
  if (!is.null(prof_lik_raw_list)) {
    scenarios <- intersect(scenarios, names(prof_lik_raw_list))
  }
  if (length(scenarios) == 0) {
    return(list(scenarios = character(0), common_scales = character(0)))
  }

  scales_by_scenario <- lapply(scenarios, function(sc) names(prof_lik_list[[sc]]))
  common_scales <- Reduce(intersect, scales_by_scenario)
  common_scales <- sort(unique(as.character(common_scales)))

  list(
    scenarios = scenarios,
    common_scales = common_scales
  )
}

extract_survey_index_like_from_raw <- function(raw_lines) {
  if (is.null(raw_lines) || length(raw_lines) == 0) return(numeric(0))

  header_idx <- which(grepl("^\\s*#\\s*Survey_index_like_by_fishery\\s*$", raw_lines))
  if (length(header_idx) == 0) return(numeric(0))

  i <- header_idx[1] + 1
  if (i > length(raw_lines)) return(numeric(0))

  block <- character(0)
  while (i <= length(raw_lines)) {
    line <- trimws(raw_lines[i])
    if (!nzchar(line) || grepl("^\\s*#", line)) break
    block <- c(block, line)
    i <- i + 1
  }
  if (length(block) == 0) return(numeric(0))

  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(strsplit(paste(block, collapse = " "), "\\s+")[[1]]))
  vals[is.finite(vals)]
}

#' Read average biomass values for scenarios
#' @param scenarios Vector of scenario names
#' @param model_dir Base model directory
get_avg_bio <- function(scenarios, model_dir = MODEL_DIR) {
  sapply(scenarios, function(x) {
    # Look for avg_bio in prof/scalar_* folders
    prof_dir <- file.path(model_dir, x, "prof")
    scalar_dirs <- list.dirs(prof_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
    scalar_dirs <- grep("scalar_\\d+$", scalar_dirs, value = TRUE)
    
    if (length(scalar_dirs) > 0) {
      # Prefer profile payload avg_bio (matches shiny behavior)
      payload_file <- file.path(scalar_dirs[1], "profile_payload.rds")
      if (file.exists(payload_file)) {
        payload_avg <- tryCatch({
          suppressWarnings(as.numeric(readRDS(payload_file)$avg_bio))
        }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
        if (is.finite(payload_avg)) return(payload_avg)
      }

      # Read from first scalar folder (value should be same across all)
      avg_bio_file <- file.path(scalar_dirs[1], "avg_bio")
      if (file.exists(avg_bio_file)) {
        return(as.numeric(read.table(avg_bio_file)))
      }
    }
    
    # Fallback: try main folder
    avg_bio_file <- file.path(model_dir, x, "avg_bio")
    if (file.exists(avg_bio_file)) {
      return(as.numeric(read.table(avg_bio_file)))
    }
    
    NA_real_
  })
}

#' Convert scalar to biomass units
#' @param scalar Numeric scalar value
#' @param scenario Scenario name
#' @param avg_bio Named vector of average biomass values
scale_to_biomass <- function(scalar, scenario, avg_bio) {
  sc <- as.numeric(scalar)
  b <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(avg_bio[as.character(scenario)]))
  out <- sc * 0.01 * b
  bad <- !is.finite(b)
  out[bad] <- sc[bad]
  out
}

#' Create a standard likelihood profile plot
#' @param data Data frame with columns: scalar, change, group_var, scenario
#' @param group_var Name of the grouping variable (e.g., "Fishery", "Likelihood")
#' @param label Annotation label for the plot
create_piner_plot <- function(data, group_var, label = NULL) {
  
  # Get unique groups excluding "Total"
  unique_groups <- unique(data[[group_var]])
  non_total_groups <- setdiff(unique_groups, "Total")
  
  # Create color palette
  color_values <- c(
    "Total" = "black",
    setNames(viridis::viridis(length(non_total_groups)), non_total_groups)
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = scalar, y = change, 
                        colour = .data[[group_var]], 
                        shape = .data[[group_var]])) +
    geom_line(aes(linewidth = .data[[group_var]] == "Total"), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(size = .data[[group_var]] == "Total"), alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_values) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.5, "FALSE" = 0.7), guide = "none") +
    scale_size_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 3.5, "FALSE" = 2), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = rep(0:24, length.out = length(unique_groups))) +
    facet_wrap(~scenario, scales = "free") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(x) x / 1000,
      name = bquote("Average biomass (" * 10^3 * " MT)")
    ) +
    labs(y = "Changes in Likelihood", colour = group_var, shape = group_var) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  
  # Add annotation if provided
  if (!is.null(label)) {
    p <- p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label,
                      hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 5, fontface = "bold")
  }
  
  return(p)
}

#' Calculate likelihood changes from minimum
#' @param data Data frame with value column
#' @param group_col Name of grouping column
calc_lik_change <- function(data, group_col) {
  data %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]], scenario) %>%
    mutate(
      min_value = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      change = value - min_value
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

#' Extract jitter diagnostics from either payload list or legacy MFCLPar object
jitter_metrics <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(list(obj_fun = NA_real_, max_grad = NA_real_))
  if (is.list(x) && !is.null(x$obj_fun) && !is.null(x$max_grad)) {
    return(list(
      obj_fun = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$obj_fun)),
      max_grad = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x$max_grad))
    ))
  }
  list(
    obj_fun = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x@obj_fun)),
    max_grad = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x@max_grad))
  )
}

#' Parse indepvar.rpt file
#' @param lines Character vector of file lines
parse_indepvar <- function(lines) {
  if (is.null(lines) || length(lines) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  data_list <- lapply(2:length(lines), function(i) {
    line <- lines[i]
    if (nchar(trimws(line)) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    hit_bound <- grepl("\\*{5,}", line)
    line_clean <- gsub("\\*+", "", line)
    parts <- strsplit(trimws(line_clean), "\\s+")[[1]]
    
    if (length(parts) >= 6) {
      data.frame(
        Index = as.integer(parts[1]),
        Var_name = parts[2],
        Estimate = as.numeric(parts[3]),
        L_bound = as.numeric(parts[4]),
        U_bound = as.numeric(parts[5]),
        Gradient = as.numeric(parts[6]),
        Hit_Bound = hit_bound,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
  
  do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), data_list))
}

#' Get fishery name from number
get_fishery_name <- function(fishery_num, mapping = fishery_map  %>% with(setNames(fishery_name, fishery))) {
  name <- mapping[as.character(fishery_num)]
  if (is.na(name)) paste("Fishery", fishery_num) else name
}

# Build model-specific fishery maps:
# prefer each scenario's fishery_map.R when available, otherwise fallback to
# the global/default map augmented with fishery IDs seen in model outputs.
load_model_fishery_map <- function(model_name) {
  map_r_candidates <- list.files(
    file.path(MODEL_DIR, model_name),
    pattern = "^fishery_map\\.[Rr]$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(map_r_candidates) > 0) {
    map_r <- map_r_candidates[1]
    env <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
    env$save <- function(...) invisible(NULL)
    ok <- tryCatch({
      sys.source(map_r, envir = env, keep.source = FALSE)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(sprintf("Failed to source %s (%s). Falling back to default fishery map.", map_r, e$message))
      FALSE
    })
    if (ok && exists("fishery_map", envir = env, inherits = FALSE)) {
      model_map <- get("fishery_map", envir = env, inherits = FALSE)
      if (is.data.frame(model_map)) {
        return(pm_normalize_fishery_map(model_map))
      }
      warning(sprintf("fishery_map in %s is not a data.frame. Falling back to default fishery map.", map_r))
    } else {
      warning(sprintf("No fishery_map object defined in %s. Falling back to default fishery map.", map_r))
    }
  } else {
    warning(sprintf(
      "fishery_map.R not found for model '%s' under %s. Using default fishery map fallback.",
      model_name, file.path(MODEL_DIR, model_name)
    ))
  }

  model_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  model_len <- LengOut_list[[model_name]]
  model_wgt <- WeightOut_list[[model_name]]
  model_tag <- TagTempOut_list[[model_name]]

  units_cpue <- tryCatch(as.numeric(unique(cpue_obs(model_rep)$unit)), error = function(e) numeric(0))
  units_len <- tryCatch(as.numeric(unique(model_len@lenfits$fishery)), error = function(e) numeric(0))
  units_wgt <- tryCatch(as.numeric(unique(model_wgt@wgtfits$fishery)), error = function(e) numeric(0))
  units_tag <- tryCatch(as.numeric(unique(model_tag$recap.fishery)), error = function(e) numeric(0))

  map_fallback <- pm_normalize_fishery_map(fishery_map)
  units_all <- sort(unique(c(units_cpue, units_len, units_wgt, units_tag)))
  units_missing <- setdiff(units_all, map_fallback$fishery)

  if (length(units_missing) > 0) {
    add_df <- tibble::tibble(
      fishery_name = paste("Fishery", units_missing),
      fishery = units_missing,
      region = NA_real_,
      group = "Unknown",
      tag_recapture_group = units_missing,
      tag_recapture_name = paste("Fishery", units_missing)
    )
    map_fallback <- dplyr::bind_rows(map_fallback, add_df) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(fishery)
  }

  pm_normalize_fishery_map(map_fallback)
}

FISHERY_MAPS <- setNames(lapply(names(ParOut_list), load_model_fishery_map), names(ParOut_list))
```

```{r model-summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(10,10)}
# MODEL SUMMARY TABLE

# Extract parameters from each model
params_df <- imap_dfr(ParOut_list, function(par, model_name) {
  
  # Safely extract values with error handling
  get_slot <- function(slot_name, default = NA) {
    tryCatch(slot(par, slot_name), error = function(e) default)
  }
  
  dims <- tryCatch(
    as.list(par@dimensions),
    error = function(e) list(
      agecls = NA, years = NA, seasons = NA,
      regions = NA, fisheries = NA, taggrps = NA
    )
  )
  
  data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    mgc = round(as.numeric(get_slot("max_grad")), 6),
    obj_fun = round(as.numeric(get_slot("obj_fun")), 2),
    n_pars = as.numeric(get_slot("n_pars")),
    agecls = dims$agecls,
    years = dims$years,
    seasons = dims$seasons,
    regions = dims$regions,
    fisheries = dims$fisheries,
    taggrps = dims$taggrps
  )
})
```

# Bound Hit Parameter Analysis {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r bound-hit-analysis, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# =============================================================================
# BOUND HIT ANALYSIS
# Identifies parameters that hit their bounds during optimization
# =============================================================================

# Separate models with and without indepvar.rpt
null_models <- names(IndepOut_list)[sapply(IndepOut_list, is.null)]
valid_models <- names(IndepOut_list)[!sapply(IndepOut_list, is.null)]

# Process each valid model
model_results <- map(setNames(valid_models, valid_models), function(model_name) {
  
  df <- parse_indepvar(IndepOut_list[[model_name]])
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  
  # Calculate distances to bounds
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Distance_to_lower = abs(Estimate - L_bound),
      Distance_to_upper = abs(Estimate - U_bound),
      Hit_Type = case_when(
        !Hit_Bound ~ "None",
        Distance_to_lower <= Distance_to_upper ~ "Lower",
        TRUE ~ "Upper"
      ),
      Distance_to_bound = if_else(
        Hit_Bound,
        if_else(Hit_Type == "Lower", Distance_to_lower, Distance_to_upper),
        NA_real_
      ),
      Var_type = str_extract(Var_name, "^[a-zA-Z_]+")
    )
  
  # Extract bound hits
  bound_hits <- df %>%
    filter(Hit_Bound) %>%
    select(Index, Var_name, Var_type, Estimate, Hit_Type,
           L_bound, U_bound, Distance_to_bound, Gradient) %>%
    arrange(Index)
  
  # Save to CSV
  write.csv(bound_hits, paste0("bound_hits_", model_name, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  list(total_params = nrow(df), bound_hits = bound_hits)
})

# Remove NULL results
model_results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), model_results)

# --- Overview Tab ---
cat("\n## Overview\n\n")

cat(sprintf("**Total Models:** %d  \n", length(IndepOut_list)))
cat(sprintf("**Models with indepvar.rpt:** %d  \n", length(valid_models)))
cat(sprintf("**Models without indepvar.rpt:** %d  \n\n", length(null_models)))

if (length(model_results) > 0) {
  overview <- data.frame(
    Model = names(model_results),
    Total_Params = sapply(model_results, function(x) x$total_params),
    Bound_Hits = sapply(model_results, function(x) nrow(x$bound_hits)),
    Hit_Rate = sapply(model_results, function(x) 
      sprintf("%.2f%%", nrow(x$bound_hits) / x$total_params * 100)),
    Lower_Hits = sapply(model_results, function(x) 
      sum(x$bound_hits$Hit_Type == "Lower")),
    Upper_Hits = sapply(model_results, function(x) 
      sum(x$bound_hits$Hit_Type == "Upper"))
  )
  
  print(
    kable(overview,
          col.names = c("Model", "Total", "Hits", "Rate", "Lower", "Upper"),
          align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
          row.names = FALSE) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                    full_width = FALSE) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#2196F3", color = "white") %>%
      column_spec(3, bold = TRUE, color = "red")
  )
}

# List models without indepvar.rpt

# --- Individual Model Tabs ---
for (model_name in names(model_results)) {
  result <- model_results[[model_name]]
  bound_hits <- result$bound_hits
  
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", model_name))
  
  cat(sprintf("**Total Parameters:** %s  \n", format(result$total_params, big.mark = ",")))
  cat(sprintf("**Bound Hits:** %d (%.2f%%)  \n", 
              nrow(bound_hits), nrow(bound_hits) / result$total_params * 100))
  cat(sprintf("**Lower Bound Hits:** %d  \n", sum(bound_hits$Hit_Type == "Lower")))
  cat(sprintf("**Upper Bound Hits:** %d  \n\n", sum(bound_hits$Hit_Type == "Upper")))
  
  if (nrow(bound_hits) > 0) {
    cat("### Bound Hit Parameters\n\n")
    
    bound_hits_display <- bound_hits %>%
      mutate(
        Estimate_fmt = sprintf("%.4e", Estimate),
        Distance_fmt = sprintf("%.2e", Distance_to_bound)
      ) %>%
      select(Index, Var_name, Var_type, Estimate_fmt, Hit_Type, 
             L_bound, U_bound, Distance_fmt)
    
    print(
      kable(bound_hits_display,
            col.names = c("Index", "Parameter", "Type", "Estimate", "Hit",
                          "Lower", "Upper", "Distance"),
            align = c("r", "l", "l", "r", "c", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                      full_width = TRUE, font_size = 11) %>%
        row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4CAF50", color = "white") %>%
        column_spec(5, bold = TRUE,
                    color = ifelse(bound_hits$Hit_Type == "Lower", "#E74C3C", "#3498DB")) %>%
        scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "400px")
    )
    
    cat("\n\n### Summary by Variable Type\n\n")
    
    type_summary <- bound_hits %>%
      count(Var_type, Hit_Type) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Hit_Type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
      mutate(Total = Lower + Upper) %>%
      arrange(desc(Total))
    
    print(
      kable(type_summary,
            col.names = c("Type", "Lower", "Upper", "Total"),
            align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                      full_width = FALSE) %>%
        row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#FF9800", color = "white") %>%
        column_spec(4, bold = TRUE)
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("\n\n*Data saved to: `bound_hits_%s.csv`*\n\n", model_name))
  } else {
    cat("\n✅ **No bound hits detected in this model**\n\n")
  }
}

# --- NULL Model Tabs ---
for (model_name in null_models) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", model_name))
  cat("⚠️ **No `indepvar.rpt` file.**\n\n")
}
```

## Spawning Biomass Depletion, Recruitment, Spawning Potential, and Fishing Mortality

```{r spawning-depletion, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(8,12)}
# =============================================================================
# SPAWNING BIOMASS DEPLETION, RECRUITMENT, SPAWNING POTENTIAL, AND FISHING MORTALITY PLOTS
# =============================================================================

# Extract spawning biomass depletion
SBdep <- GetQuantSimple(SBSBF0, RepOut_list, minYear, maxYear)

# Calculate recruitment using the same method as model_rec
scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)
rec_all <- data.frame()

# Extract recruitment data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  rec_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@rec_region) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])

  rec_all <- bind_rows(rec_all, rec_temp)
}

# Create total recruitment dataset by summing across all regions and seasons
rec_total <- rec_all %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(data = sum(data) / 1e6, .groups = "drop")  # Convert to millions

# Rename columns to match expected format
Rec <- rec_total %>%
  rename(Year = year, Quant = data, Scenario = scenario)

# =============================================================================
# Extract Spawning Potential (with fishing only)
# =============================================================================

bioFish_all <- data.frame()

# Extract biomass with fishing from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  bioFish_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@adultBiomass) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  
  bioFish_all <- bind_rows(bioFish_all, bioFish_temp)
}

# Calculate spawning potential with fishing across all areas
SpawnPot <- bioFish_all %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(data = sum(data), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(data = mean(data) / 1e3, .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(Year = year, Quant = data, Scenario = scenario)

# =============================================================================
# Calculate Instantaneous Age-Averaged Fishing Mortality (Approximation)
# =============================================================================

fm_all <- data.frame()
popn_all <- data.frame()

# Extract data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  # Extract fishing mortality (harvest rate)
  fm_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@fm) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  fm_all <- bind_rows(fm_all, fm_temp)
  
  # Extract population numbers
  popn_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@popN) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i]) %>%
    rename(N = data)
  popn_all <- bind_rows(popn_all, popn_temp)
}

# Calculate instantaneous F using approximation: F ≈ -ln(1 - C/N)
# Note: This is a simple approximation that works well when harvest rates are moderate
FM <- fm_all %>%
  left_join(popn_all, by = c("age", "year", "unit", "season", "area", "iter", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    catch = data * N  # Catch = harvest rate * population
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    total_catch = sum(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_N = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    harvest_rate = total_catch / total_N,
    # Approximate instantaneous F: F ≈ -ln(1 - C/N)
    inst_F = -log(pmax(1 - harvest_rate, 0.001))
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    # Sum instantaneous F across seasons to get annual F
    Quant = sum(inst_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Year = year, Scenario = scenario)

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette and convert to factors
# =============================================================================

scenario_levels <- unique(SBdep$Scenario)
scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenario_levels)

# Convert to factor for consistent ordering
SBdep$Scenario <- factor(SBdep$Scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
Rec$Scenario <- factor(Rec$Scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
SpawnPot$Scenario <- factor(SpawnPot$Scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
FM$Scenario <- factor(FM$Scenario, levels = scenario_levels)

# =============================================================================
# Create plots
# =============================================================================

# Common theme for all plots
common_theme <- theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

# Plot 1: Spawning Biomass Depletion (SB/SBF=0)
SBdepPlot <- ggplot(SBdep, aes(x = Year, y = Quant, color = Scenario, group = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = bquote(SB/SB["F=0"])) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
  common_theme

# Plot 2: Recruitment
RecPlot <- ggplot(Rec, aes(x = Year, y = Quant, color = Scenario, group = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Recruitment (Millions)") +
  common_theme

# Plot 3: Spawning Potential (with fishing)
SpawnPotPlot <- ggplot(SpawnPot, aes(x = Year, y = Quant, color = Scenario, group = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = bquote("Spawning Potential (" * 10^3 * " MT)")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  common_theme

# Plot 4: Age-Averaged Instantaneous Fishing Mortality
FMPlot <- ggplot(FM, aes(x = Year, y = Quant, color = Scenario, group = Scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Annual Instantaneous F") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  common_theme

# =============================================================================
# Extract legend
# =============================================================================

# Extract scenario color legend
scenario_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ggplot(SBdep, aes(x = Year, y = Quant, color = Scenario)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(color = "Scenario") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)))
)

# =============================================================================
# Combine plots and legends
# =============================================================================

# Combine all four plots vertically
combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  SBdepPlot, RecPlot, SpawnPotPlot, FMPlot,
  ncol = 1, align = "v"
)

# Add legend to the right side
final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  combined_plot, scenario_legend,
  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(3.2, 1.3)
)

print(final_plot)
```

## Depletion by Area

```{r model_depletion_area, echo=FALSE, message=F, fig.dim=c(10,8)}

# =============================================================================
# Calculate depletion (biomass with fishing / biomass without fishing)
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

# Initialize empty data frames
bioNoFish_all <- data.frame()
bioFish_all <- data.frame()

# Extract biomass without fishing data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  bioNoFish_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@adultBiomass_nofish) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  bioNoFish_all <- bind_rows(bioNoFish_all, bioNoFish_temp)
}

# Extract biomass with fishing data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  bioFish_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@adultBiomass) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  bioFish_all <- bind_rows(bioFish_all, bioFish_temp)
}

# Aggregate by year and area for both datasets
bioNoFish_yearly <- bioNoFish_all %>%
  group_by(year, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_nofish = sum(data) / n_distinct(season), .groups = "drop")

bioFish_yearly <- bioFish_all %>%
  group_by(year, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_fish = sum(data) / n_distinct(season), .groups = "drop")

# Join and calculate depletion by area
depletion_area <- bioFish_yearly %>%
  left_join(bioNoFish_yearly, by = c("year", "area", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(depletion = biomass_fish / biomass_nofish)

# Calculate depletion for all areas combined
bioNoFish_all_areas <- bioNoFish_all %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_nofish = sum(data), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_nofish = mean(biomass_nofish), .groups = "drop")

bioFish_all_areas <- bioFish_all %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_fish = sum(data), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(biomass_fish = mean(biomass_fish), .groups = "drop")

depletion_all <- bioFish_all_areas %>%
  left_join(bioNoFish_all_areas, by = c("year", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(depletion = biomass_fish / biomass_nofish,
         area = "All")

# Combine area-specific and all-areas depletion
depletion_combined <- bind_rows(depletion_area, depletion_all)

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette and convert to factors
# =============================================================================

scenario_levels <- unique(depletion_combined$scenario)
scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenario_levels)

# Convert scenario to factor for consistent ordering
depletion_combined$scenario <- factor(depletion_combined$scenario, levels = scenario_levels)

# =============================================================================
# Create plot
# =============================================================================

depletion_plot <- ggplot(depletion_combined, aes(x = year, y = depletion, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = config$linewidth, alpha = config$alpha) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ area, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = bquote(SB/SB["F=0"])) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

# =============================================================================
# Extract legend
# =============================================================================

scenario_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ggplot(depletion_combined, aes(x = year, y = depletion, color = scenario)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(color = "Scenario") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)))
)

# =============================================================================
# Combine plot and legend
# =============================================================================

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  depletion_plot, scenario_legend,
  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(3.2, 1.3)
)

print(final_plot)
```

## Juvenile and Adult Fishing Mortality by Area (Instantaneous F)

```{r model_fm_juv_adult_area_inst, echo=FALSE, message=F, fig.dim=c(10,8)}

# =============================================================================
# Calculate Instantaneous Juvenile vs Adult Fishing Mortality by Area
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

# Initialize data frames for FM, maturity, population, and natural mortality
fm_all <- data.frame()
mat_all <- data.frame()
popn_all <- data.frame()

# Extract data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  # Extract fishing mortality by area (not aggregated)
  fm_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@fm) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  fm_all <- bind_rows(fm_all, fm_temp)
  
  # Extract population numbers
  popn_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@popN) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i]) %>%
    rename(N = data)
  popn_all <- bind_rows(popn_all, popn_temp)
  
  # Extract maturity and stack by age then season to get age 1-40
  # Age 0 season 1-4 -> ages 1-4, Age 1 season 1-4 -> ages 5-8, etc.
  mat_temp <- as.data.frame(ParOut_list[[i]]@mat) %>%
    arrange(age, season) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i],
           age_new = row_number()) %>%
    select(age = age_new, maturity = data, scenario)
  
  mat_all <- bind_rows(mat_all, mat_temp)
}

# Calculate instantaneous juvenile and adult fishing mortality by area
# Note: Using approximation F ≈ -ln(1 - C/N) for instantaneous fishing mortality
# This is a simple approximation that works well when harvest rates are moderate
fm_juv_adult_area <- fm_all %>%
  left_join(popn_all, by = c("age", "year", "unit", "season", "area", "iter", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(age_num = as.numeric(as.character(age))) %>%
  left_join(mat_all, by = c("age_num" = "age", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    juv = (1 - maturity) * N,        # Juvenile population
    adult = maturity * N,             # Adult population
    catch.juv = data * juv,           # Juvenile catch
    catch.adult = data * adult        # Adult catch
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, season, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    catch.juv = sum(catch.juv, na.rm = TRUE),
    juv = sum(juv, na.rm = TRUE),
    catch.adult = sum(catch.adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    adult = sum(adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    harvest_rate.juv = catch.juv / juv,
    harvest_rate.adult = catch.adult / adult,
    # Approximate instantaneous F: F ≈ -ln(1 - C/N)
    F.juv = -log(pmax(1 - harvest_rate.juv, 0.001)),
    F.adult = -log(pmax(1 - harvest_rate.adult, 0.001))
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    F.juv = sum(F.juv, na.rm = TRUE),    # Annual instantaneous juvenile F
    F.adult = sum(F.adult, na.rm = TRUE), # Annual instantaneous adult F
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate for all areas combined
fm_juv_adult_all <- fm_all %>%
  left_join(popn_all, by = c("age", "year", "unit", "season", "area", "iter", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(age_num = as.numeric(as.character(age))) %>%
  left_join(mat_all, by = c("age_num" = "age", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    juv = (1 - maturity) * N,
    adult = maturity * N,
    catch.juv = data * juv,
    catch.adult = data * adult
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    catch.juv = sum(catch.juv, na.rm = TRUE),
    juv = sum(juv, na.rm = TRUE),
    catch.adult = sum(catch.adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    adult = sum(adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    harvest_rate.juv = catch.juv / juv,
    harvest_rate.adult = catch.adult / adult,
    F.juv = -log(pmax(1 - harvest_rate.juv, 0.001)),
    F.adult = -log(pmax(1 - harvest_rate.adult, 0.001))
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    F.juv = sum(F.juv, na.rm = TRUE),
    F.adult = sum(F.adult, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(area = "All")

# Combine area-specific and all-areas data
fm_juv_adult_combined <- bind_rows(fm_juv_adult_area, fm_juv_adult_all)

# Reshape data for plotting
fm_plot_data <- fm_juv_adult_combined %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(F.juv, F.adult), names_to = "type", values_to = "F") %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, 
                      levels = c("F.juv", "F.adult"),
                      labels = c("Juvenile F", "Adult F")))

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette and convert to factors
# =============================================================================

scenario_levels <- unique(fm_plot_data$scenario)
scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenario_levels)

# Convert scenario to factor for consistent ordering
fm_plot_data$scenario <- factor(fm_plot_data$scenario, levels = scenario_levels)

# =============================================================================
# Create plot
# =============================================================================

fm_area_plot <- ggplot(fm_plot_data, aes(x = year, y = F, color = scenario, linetype = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = config$linewidth, alpha = config$alpha) +
  scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Life Stage", 
                       values = c("Juvenile F" = "dashed", "Adult F" = "solid")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  facet_wrap(~ area, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Annual Instantaneous F") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

# =============================================================================
# Extract legends
# =============================================================================

# Extract scenario color legend
scenario_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ggplot(fm_plot_data, aes(x = year, y = F, color = scenario)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = scenario_colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm")
    ) +
    labs(color = "Scenario") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)))
)

# Extract life stage linetype legend
lifestage_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  ggplot(fm_plot_data, aes(x = year, y = F, linetype = type)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 2) +
    scale_linetype_manual(name = "Life Stage", 
                         values = c("Juvenile F" = "dashed", "Adult F" = "solid")) +
    guides(linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.5))) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.8, "cm")
    )
)

# Combine legends vertically
combined_legend <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  scenario_legend, lifestage_legend,
  ncol = 1
)

# =============================================================================
# Combine plot and legends
# =============================================================================

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fm_area_plot, combined_legend,
  ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(3.2, 1.3)
)

print(final_plot)


```




## Area Contribution to Total Fishing Mortality

```{r model_fm_area_contribution, echo=FALSE, message=F, fig.dim=c(10,8)}

# =============================================================================
# Calculate area contribution to total F (based on F values, not catch)
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

# Initialize data frames for FM, maturity, population, and natural mortality
fm_all <- data.frame()
mat_all <- data.frame()
popn_all <- data.frame()
m_all <- data.frame()

# Extract data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(RepOut_list)) {
  # Extract fishing mortality by area (not aggregated)
  fm_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@fm) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i])
  fm_all <- bind_rows(fm_all, fm_temp)
  
  # Extract population numbers
  popn_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@popN) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i]) %>%
    rename(N = data)
  popn_all <- bind_rows(popn_all, popn_temp)
  
  # Extract maturity and stack by age then season to get age 1-40
  mat_temp <- as.data.frame(ParOut_list[[i]]@mat) %>%
    arrange(age, season) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i],
           age_new = row_number()) %>%
    select(age = age_new, maturity = data, scenario)
  
  mat_all <- bind_rows(mat_all, mat_temp)
  
  # Extract natural mortality and stack by age then season to get age 1-40
  m_temp <- as.data.frame(RepOut_list[[i]]@m_at_age) %>%
    arrange(age, season) %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenarios_name[i],
           age_new = row_number()) %>%
    select(age = age_new, M = data, scenario)
  
  m_all <- bind_rows(m_all, m_temp)
}

# Calculate catch, population, and F by area and season
area_data <- fm_all %>%
  left_join(popn_all, by = c("age", "year", "unit", "season", "area", "iter", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(age_num = as.numeric(as.character(age))) %>%
  left_join(mat_all, by = c("age_num" = "age", "scenario")) %>%
  left_join(m_all, by = c("age_num" = "age", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(
    catch = data * N  # Catch by area
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, season, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    catch = sum(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    F_season = -log(1 - pmin(catch / N, 0.99))  # Seasonal F by area
  )

# Calculate annual F by area
area_F <- area_data %>%
  group_by(year, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    F_area = sum(F_season, na.rm = TRUE),  # Annual F by area
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate total F across all areas
total_F <- fm_all %>%
  left_join(popn_all, by = c("age", "year", "unit", "season", "area", "iter", "scenario")) %>%
  mutate(age_num = as.numeric(as.character(age))) %>%
  mutate(catch = data * N) %>%
  group_by(year, season, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    catch = sum(catch, na.rm = TRUE),
    N = sum(N, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(F_season = -log(1 - pmin(catch / N, 0.99))) %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    F_total = sum(F_season, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Calculate F contribution: weighted by population
# Contribution = (F_area * N_area) / (F_total * N_total) * 100
area_contribution <- area_data %>%
  group_by(year, area, scenario) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_F = sum(F_season * N, na.rm = TRUE),  # F weighted by population
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, scenario) %>%
  mutate(
    total_weighted_F = sum(weighted_F),
    contribution = (weighted_F / total_weighted_F) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette and convert to factors
# =============================================================================

scenario_levels <- unique(area_contribution$scenario)

# Convert to factor for consistent ordering
area_contribution$scenario <- factor(area_contribution$scenario, levels = scenario_levels)
area_contribution$area <- factor(area_contribution$area)

# =============================================================================
# Create stacked area plot
# =============================================================================

contribution_plot <- ggplot(area_contribution, aes(x = year, y = contribution, fill = area)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Area") +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Contribution to Total F (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

print(contribution_plot)

```

# Estimation Diagnostics (Jitter analysis) {.tabset}

```{r jitter-analysis, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', fig.dim=c(12,8)}
# Get scenarios with jitter runs
scenarios_with_jitter <- names(JitterPars_list)[sapply(JitterPars_list, function(x) length(x) > 0)]

if (length(scenarios_with_jitter) > 0) {
  
  # Collect all data including max_grad
  all_jitter_data <- list()
  
  for (scenario in scenarios_with_jitter) {
    jitter_pars <- JitterPars_list[[scenario]]
    base_par <- ParOut_list[[scenario]]
    seeds <- names(jitter_pars)
    
    if (length(seeds) == 0) next
    
    ref_obj <- as.numeric(base_par@obj_fun)
    ref_grad <- base_par@max_grad
    
    jitter_obj <- sapply(jitter_pars, function(p) jitter_metrics(p)$obj_fun)
    jitter_grad <- sapply(jitter_pars, function(p) jitter_metrics(p)$max_grad)
    
    # Percent difference from reference
    pct_diff <- ((jitter_obj - ref_obj) / abs(ref_obj)) * 100
    
    all_jitter_data[[scenario]] <- data.frame(
      scenario = scenario,
      obj_fun = jitter_obj,
      ref_obj = ref_obj,
      pct_diff = pct_diff,
      max_grad = jitter_grad,
      ref_grad = ref_grad,
      jitter_id = seq_along(jitter_grad)
    )
  }
  
  # Combine all data
  plot_df <- do.call(rbind, all_jitter_data)
  
  # Identify outliers
  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_outlier = pct_diff < -5 | pct_diff > 20,
      outlier_direction = case_when(
        pct_diff < -5 ~ "below",
        pct_diff > 20 ~ "above",
        TRUE ~ "none"
      )
    )
  
  # Create reference model dataframe
  ref_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    select(scenario, ref_obj, ref_grad)
  
  # Separate outliers
  outliers_df <- plot_df %>% filter(is_outlier)
  
  # Scatter plot with jitter_id as continuous color
  p <- ggplot(plot_df %>% filter(!is_outlier), aes(x = max_grad, y = pct_diff)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = jitter_id), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Outliers at plot edges with arrows
    geom_point(data = outliers_df %>% filter(outlier_direction == "above"),
               aes(x = max_grad, y = 19.5), 
               color = "orange", size = 3, shape = 24, fill = "orange") +
    geom_point(data = outliers_df %>% filter(outlier_direction == "below"),
               aes(x = max_grad, y = -4.5), 
               color = "orange", size = 3, shape = 25, fill = "orange") +
    geom_point(data = ref_df, aes(x = ref_grad, y = 0), 
               color = "red", size = 5, shape = 18) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.001, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", 
                          name = "Jitter ID") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-5, 20)) +
    facet_wrap(~scenario, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    labs(x = "Maximum Gradient (log scale)", 
         y = "% Difference in Objective Function",
         title = "Jitter Analysis: Convergence Diagnostics",
         subtitle = "Red diamond = Reference Model | Gray line = 0.001 reference | Orange triangles = Outliers") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "lightblue"),
          legend.position = "right")
  
  print(p)
  
  cat("\\n\\n")
  
  # Summary table
  cat("### Summary Statistics\\n\\n")
  
  summary_list <- lapply(split(plot_df, plot_df$scenario), function(df) {
    data.frame(
      scenario = unique(df$scenario),
      ref_obj = sprintf("%.2f", unique(df$ref_obj)),
      ref_grad = sprintf("%.4f", unique(df$ref_grad)),
      n_jitter = nrow(df),
      pct_diff_min = sprintf("%.2f%%", min(df$pct_diff)),
      pct_diff_median = sprintf("%.2f%%", median(df$pct_diff)),
      pct_diff_max = sprintf("%.2f%%", max(df$pct_diff)),
      grad_min = sprintf("%.4f", min(df$max_grad)),
      grad_median = sprintf("%.4f", median(df$max_grad)),
      grad_max = sprintf("%.4f", max(df$max_grad)),
      n_outliers_above = sum(df$pct_diff > 20),
      n_outliers_below = sum(df$pct_diff < -5)
    )
  })
  
  summary_df <- do.call(rbind, summary_list)
  rownames(summary_df) <- NULL
  
  print(
    kable(summary_df,
          col.names = c("Scenario", "Ref Obj", "Ref Grad", "N", 
                        "% Diff Min", "% Diff Med", "% Diff Max",
                        "Grad Min", "Grad Med", "Grad Max", 
                        "Outliers ▲", "Outliers ▼"),
          align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                    full_width = FALSE) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#673AB7", color = "white")
  )
  
} else {
  cat("*No jitter analysis results found in any model folder.*\\n\\n")
}
```

## Hessian Diagnostics (PDH / SPD)

```{r hessian-diagnostics, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
hessian_rows <- lapply(names(ParOut_list), function(sc) {
  hfile <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, sc, "hessian", "hessian_info.rds")
  part_files <- list.files(
    file.path(MODEL_DIR, sc, "hessian"),
    pattern = "^part_\\d+/hessian_info\\.rds$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    recursive = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!file.exists(hfile)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Scenario = sc,
      Hessian_File = "Missing",
      PDH = NA_character_,
      `SPD (positivised cov)` = NA_character_,
      `Neg. Eigen` = NA_character_,
      `Hessian Status` = NA_character_,
      Reliability = NA_character_,
      `Stitch Complete` = NA_character_,
      `Parts (found/expected)` = ifelse(length(part_files) > 0, as.character(length(part_files)), NA_character_),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  info <- tryCatch(readRDS(hfile), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(info)) {
    return(data.frame(
      Scenario = sc,
      Hessian_File = "Read error",
      PDH = NA_character_,
      `SPD (positivised cov)` = NA_character_,
      `Neg. Eigen` = NA_character_,
      `Hessian Status` = NA_character_,
      Reliability = NA_character_,
      `Stitch Complete` = NA_character_,
      `Parts (found/expected)` = ifelse(length(part_files) > 0, as.character(length(part_files)), NA_character_),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  is_pdh <- tryCatch(info$diagnostics$summary$pdh$is_pdh, error = function(e) NA)
  spd_pos_cov <- tryCatch(info$diagnostics$summary$positivised_cov_is_spd, error = function(e) NA)
  n_neg <- tryCatch(info$eigen$n_negative_eigenvalues, error = function(e) NA)
  n_tot <- tryCatch(info$eigen$n_total_eigenvalues, error = function(e) NA)
  h_status <- tryCatch(info$eigen$hessian_status, error = function(e) NA_character_)
  reliability <- tryCatch(info$eigen$reliability, error = function(e) NA_character_)
  stitch_complete <- tryCatch(info$stitch$is_complete, error = function(e) NA)
  n_parts_expected <- tryCatch(info$stitch$n_parts, error = function(e) NA)
  found_parts <- if (length(part_files) > 0) length(part_files) else as.integer(n_parts_expected)
  
  data.frame(
    Scenario = sc,
    Hessian_File = "OK",
    PDH = dplyr::case_when(
      isTRUE(is_pdh) ~ "PDH",
      identical(is_pdh, FALSE) ~ "Not PDH",
      TRUE ~ "NA"
    ),
    `SPD (positivised cov)` = dplyr::case_when(
      isTRUE(spd_pos_cov) ~ "SPD",
      identical(spd_pos_cov, FALSE) ~ "Not SPD",
      TRUE ~ "NA"
    ),
    `Neg. Eigen` = ifelse(
      is.na(n_neg) || is.na(n_tot),
      NA_character_,
      sprintf("%d / %d", as.integer(n_neg), as.integer(n_tot))
    ),
    `Hessian Status` = as.character(h_status),
    Reliability = as.character(reliability),
    `Stitch Complete` = dplyr::case_when(
      isTRUE(stitch_complete) ~ "Yes",
      identical(stitch_complete, FALSE) ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ "NA"
    ),
    `Parts (found/expected)` = ifelse(
      is.na(n_parts_expected),
      as.character(found_parts),
      sprintf("%d / %d", as.integer(found_parts), as.integer(n_parts_expected))
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

hessian_df <- bind_rows(hessian_rows)

if (nrow(hessian_df) > 0) {
  print(
    kable(
      hessian_df,
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")
    ) %>%
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
        full_width = FALSE
      ) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#00695C", color = "white")
  )
  
  cat("\\n\\n")
  cat("`PDH`: whether the Hessian is positive definite | `SPD (positivised cov)`: whether the positivised covariance is SPD\\n\\n")
} else {
  cat("*No Hessian diagnostics found.*\\n\\n")
}
```

# Retrospective Diagnostics {.tabset}

## Depletion and Spawning Potential by Peel

```{r retrospective-analysis, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.dim=c(12,10)}
# =============================================================================
# RETROSPECTIVE DIAGNOSTICS
# Overlay base + retrospective peels for depletion and spawning potential.
# =============================================================================

retro_scenarios <- names(ParOut_list)[vapply(names(ParOut_list), function(sc) {
  dir.exists(file.path(MODEL_DIR, sc, "retro"))
}, logical(1))]

extract_retro_metrics <- function(rep_obj, scenario, peel) {
  bio_fish <- as.data.frame(rep_obj@adultBiomass) %>%
    group_by(year, season) %>%
    summarise(bio_fish = sum(data), .groups = "drop")
  
  bio_nofish <- as.data.frame(rep_obj@adultBiomass_nofish) %>%
    group_by(year, season) %>%
    summarise(bio_nofish = sum(data), .groups = "drop")
  
  dep <- bio_fish %>%
    inner_join(bio_nofish, by = c("year", "season")) %>%
    mutate(depletion = bio_fish / pmax(bio_nofish, .Machine$double.eps)) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(depletion = mean(depletion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  sp <- bio_fish %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(spawning_potential = mean(bio_fish, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e3, .groups = "drop")
  
  dep %>%
    inner_join(sp, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(scenario = scenario, peel = peel)
}

retro_data <- list()

for (sc in retro_scenarios) {
  # Base run as peel = 0
  if (!is.null(RepOut_list[[sc]])) {
    retro_data[[paste0(sc, "_peel_0")]] <- extract_retro_metrics(RepOut_list[[sc]], sc, 0)
  }
  
  retro_dir <- file.path(MODEL_DIR, sc, "retro")
  peel_dirs <- list.dirs(retro_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
  peel_dirs <- peel_dirs[grepl("peel_\\d+$", peel_dirs)]
  
  for (pd in peel_dirs) {
    peel_num <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(basename(pd), "\\d+$"))
    metrics_file <- file.path(pd, "retro_metrics.rds")
    if (file.exists(metrics_file)) {
      m <- tryCatch(readRDS(metrics_file), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(m) && nrow(m) > 0) {
        retro_data[[paste0(sc, "_peel_", peel_num)]] <- m
        next
      }
    }

    rep_path <- tryCatch(finalRep(pd), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(rep_path) || !file.exists(rep_path)) next

    rep_obj <- tryCatch(read.MFCLRep(rep_path), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(rep_obj)) next

    retro_data[[paste0(sc, "_peel_", peel_num)]] <- extract_retro_metrics(rep_obj, sc, peel_num)
  }
}

retro_df <- bind_rows(retro_data)

if (nrow(retro_df) > 0) {
  retro_df <- retro_df %>%
    mutate(
      scenario = factor(scenario, levels = unique(scenario)),
      peel = as.integer(peel)
    )
  
  peel_levels <- sort(unique(retro_df$peel))
  peel_levels_chr <- as.character(peel_levels)
  terminal_by_peel <- retro_df %>%
    group_by(scenario, peel) %>%
    summarise(terminal_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(peel) %>%
    summarise(
      terminal_year = ifelse(n_distinct(terminal_year) == 1,
                             dplyr::first(terminal_year),
                             max(terminal_year, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(peel)
  
  peel_labels <- setNames(as.character(terminal_by_peel$terminal_year), as.character(terminal_by_peel$peel))
  
  peel_colors <- if (length(peel_levels) == 1) {
    c("0" = "black")
  } else {
    c(
      "0" = "black",
      setNames(
        viridis(length(peel_levels[peel_levels > 0]), option = "C", direction = -1),
        as.character(peel_levels[peel_levels > 0])
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Mohn's rho (scenario-wise): mean relative deviation at each peel terminal year
  eps <- .Machine$double.eps
  base_terminal <- retro_df %>%
    filter(peel == 0) %>%
    select(
      scenario, year,
      depletion_base = depletion,
      spawning_potential_base = spawning_potential
    )
  
  peel_terminal <- retro_df %>%
    filter(peel > 0) %>%
    group_by(scenario, peel) %>%
    filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    summarise(
      year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
      depletion_peel = dplyr::last(depletion),
      spawning_potential_peel = dplyr::last(spawning_potential),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  mohn_components <- peel_terminal %>%
    left_join(base_terminal, by = c("scenario", "year")) %>%
    mutate(
      rho_dep_component = (depletion_peel - depletion_base) / pmax(abs(depletion_base), eps),
      rho_sp_component = (spawning_potential_peel - spawning_potential_base) / pmax(abs(spawning_potential_base), eps)
    )
  
  mohn_summary_num <- mohn_components %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    summarise(
      n_peels_dep = sum(!is.na(rho_dep_component)),
      n_peels_sp = sum(!is.na(rho_sp_component)),
      mohn_rho_depletion = ifelse(n_peels_dep > 0, mean(rho_dep_component, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      mohn_rho_spawning_potential = ifelse(n_peels_sp > 0, mean(rho_sp_component, na.rm = TRUE), NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(scenario)
  
  dep_anno <- mohn_summary_num %>%
    transmute(scenario, label = sprintf("Mohn's rho: %.3f", mohn_rho_depletion))
  
  sp_anno <- mohn_summary_num %>%
    transmute(scenario, label = sprintf("Mohn's rho: %.3f", mohn_rho_spawning_potential))
  
  dep_plot <- ggplot(
    retro_df,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = depletion,
      color = factor(peel, levels = peel_levels_chr),
      group = interaction(scenario, peel)
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text(
      data = dep_anno,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~scenario, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = peel_colors, breaks = peel_levels_chr, labels = peel_labels) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.2, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = bquote(SB/SB["F=0"]),
      color = "Peel",
      title = "Retrospective Depletion"
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1)) +
    theme_bw()
  
  sp_plot <- ggplot(
    retro_df,
    aes(
      x = year,
      y = spawning_potential,
      color = factor(peel, levels = peel_levels_chr),
      group = interaction(scenario, peel)
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text(
      data = sp_anno,
      aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 3.4, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~scenario, scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = peel_colors, breaks = peel_levels_chr, labels = peel_labels) +
    labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = bquote("Spawning Potential (" * 10^3 * " MT)"),
      color = "Peel",
      title = "Retrospective Spawning Potential"
    ) +
    theme_bw()
  
  print(cowplot::plot_grid(dep_plot, sp_plot, ncol = 1, align = "v"))
  
} else {
  cat("*No retrospective outputs found (`retro/peel_*`) in model folders.*\\n\\n")
}
```

# Likelihood Diagnostics {.tabset}

## Each component

```{r lik-profile-components, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(11,8)}
# =============================================================================
# LIKELIHOOD PROFILE BY COMPONENT
# Shows how each likelihood component changes across biomass scalars
# =============================================================================

prof_ctx <- get_profile_context(Info_list, ProfLikOut_list, ProfLikOutRaw_list)
scenarios_prof <- prof_ctx$scenarios

if (length(scenarios_prof) > 0) {

  # Get average biomass for scaling
  avg_bio <- get_avg_bio(scenarios_prof)

  Likes_long <- purrr::map_dfr(scenarios_prof, function(sc) {
    sc_scales <- names(ProfLikOut_list[[sc]])
    purrr::map_dfr(sc_scales, function(scl) {
      lik <- ProfLikOut_list[[sc]][[scl]]
      raw <- ProfLikOutRaw_list[[sc]][[scl]]
      if (is.null(lik)) return(data.frame())

      vals <- c(
        Indices   = sum(lik@survey_index, na.rm = TRUE),
        LFs       = sum(lik@total_length_fish, na.rm = TRUE),
        Penalties = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw[6])),
        WFs       = sum(lik@total_weight_fish, na.rm = TRUE),
        Age       = sum(lik@age_length, na.rm = TRUE),
        Tags      = sum(unlist(lik@tag_rel_fish, recursive = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
      )
      vals <- c(vals, Total = sum(vals, na.rm = TRUE))

      data.frame(
        scenario = sc,
        scalar = scl,
        Likelihood = names(vals),
        value = as.numeric(vals),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(scalar = scale_to_biomass(scalar, scenario, avg_bio))

  # Calculate change from minimum
  if (nrow(Likes_long) > 0) {
    Likes_change <- calc_lik_change(Likes_long, "Likelihood")
    print(create_piner_plot(Likes_change, "Likelihood"))
  } else {
    cat("*No likelihood-component profile data available.*\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*No profile outputs (`prof/scalar_*/profile_payload.rds`) were found across selected scenarios.*\n\n")
}
```

## Piner (CPUEs)

```{r piner-CPUEs, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(11,8)}
# =============================================================================
# PINER PLOT: INDEX CPUE LIKELIHOODS BY FISHERY
# =============================================================================


prof_ctx <- get_profile_context(Info_list, ProfLikOut_list, ProfLikOutRaw_list)
scenarios_prof <- prof_ctx$scenarios

if (length(scenarios_prof) > 0) {
  avg_bio <- get_avg_bio(scenarios_prof)

  Likes_long <- purrr::map_dfr(scenarios_prof, function(sc) {
    sc_scales <- names(ProfLikOutRaw_list[[sc]])
    purrr::map_dfr(sc_scales, function(scl) {
      raw <- ProfLikOutRaw_list[[sc]][[scl]]
      cpue_vec <- extract_survey_index_like_from_raw(raw)
      if (length(cpue_vec) == 0) return(data.frame())

      fish_ids <- as.character(seq_along(cpue_vec))
      keep_idx <- is.finite(cpue_vec) & abs(cpue_vec) > 0
      cpue_vec <- cpue_vec[keep_idx]
      fish_ids <- fish_ids[keep_idx]
      if (length(cpue_vec) == 0) return(data.frame())

      fish_names <- sapply(fish_ids, function(fid) get_fishery_name(fid))
      out <- data.frame(
        scenario = sc,
        scalar = scl,
        Fishery = fish_names,
        value = as.numeric(cpue_vec),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      bind_rows(
        out,
        data.frame(scenario = sc, scalar = scl, Fishery = "Total", value = sum(cpue_vec), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(scalar = scale_to_biomass(scalar, scenario, avg_bio))

  if (nrow(Likes_long) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("CPUE profile rows: %d | fisheries: %d | scenarios: %d\n\n",
                nrow(Likes_long),
                dplyr::n_distinct(Likes_long$Fishery),
                dplyr::n_distinct(Likes_long$scenario)))
    Likes_change <- calc_lik_change(Likes_long, "Fishery")
    print(create_piner_plot(Likes_change, "Fishery", "CPUEs"))
  } else {
    cat("*No CPUE profile rows parsed from `# Survey_index_like_by_fishery` blocks.*\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*No CPUE profile outputs were found across selected scenarios.*\n\n")
}
```

## Piner (Tagging)

```{r piner-tag, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(11,8)}
# =============================================================================
# PINER PLOT: TAGGING LIKELIHOODS BY PROGRAM
# =============================================================================

prof_ctx <- get_profile_context(Info_list, ProfLikOut_list, ProfLikOutRaw_list)
scenarios_prof <- prof_ctx$scenarios

if (length(scenarios_prof) > 0) {
  avg_bio <- get_avg_bio(scenarios_prof)
  
  # Extract tag likelihoods by program
  Likes_long <- purrr::map_dfr(scenarios_prof, function(sc) {
    sc_scales <- names(ProfLikOut_list[[sc]])
    purrr::map_dfr(sc_scales, function(scl) {
      tag_rel <- ProfLikOut_list[[sc]][[scl]]@tag_rel_fish
      sums_vec <- sapply(tag_rel, function(g) sum(unlist(g)))
      program_names <- tag_program_maps[[sc]]$program_name[seq_along(sums_vec)]
      if (length(program_names) != length(sums_vec)) {
        program_names <- paste("Program", seq_along(sums_vec))
      }
      data.frame(
        scenario = sc,
        scalar = scl,
        program = as.character(program_names),
        value = as.numeric(sums_vec),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(scalar = scale_to_biomass(scalar, scenario, avg_bio)) %>%
    group_by(program, scalar, scenario) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Add total
  Likes_total <- Likes_long %>%
    group_by(scalar, scenario) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(program = "Total")
  
  Likes_long <- bind_rows(Likes_long, Likes_total)
  
  if (nrow(Likes_long) > 0) {
    Likes_change <- calc_lik_change(Likes_long, "program")
    print(create_piner_plot(Likes_change, "program", "Tagging program"))
```

## Piner (CAL by fishery)

```{r piner-cal-fishery, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(11,8)}
# =============================================================================
# PINER PLOT: CONDITIONAL AGE-AT-LENGTH BY FISHERY
# =============================================================================

prof_ctx <- get_profile_context(Info_list, ProfLikOut_list, ProfLikOutRaw_list)
scenarios_prof <- prof_ctx$scenarios
scales <- prof_ctx$common_scales
avg_bio <- get_avg_bio(scenarios_prof)

if (length(scenarios_prof) == 0 || length(scales) == 0) {
  cat("*No shared CAL-by-fishery profile outputs were found.*\n\n")
} else {
  # Extract CAL likelihood data for all scenarios
  age_lik_data <- map_dfr(scenarios_prof, function(sc) {

    # Get unique year-month-fishery combinations
    alk_summary <- as.data.frame(AgeOut_list[[sc]]@ALK) %>%
      mutate(order = row_number()) %>%
      group_by(year, month, fishery) %>%
      summarise(first_order = min(order), .groups = "drop") %>%
      arrange(first_order) %>%
      select(-first_order)

    # Add likelihood values for each scalar
    map_dfr(scales, function(scl) {
      lik_vec <- ProfLikOut_list[[sc]][[scl]]@age_length
      alk_summary %>%
        mutate(
          scenario = sc,
          scalar = scale_to_biomass(scl, sc, avg_bio),
          Lik = lik_vec[seq_len(nrow(alk_summary))]
        )
    })
  })

  # Map fishery numbers to names
  age_lik_data <- age_lik_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(fishery = (fishery_map %>% with(setNames(fishery_name, fishery)))[as.character(fishery)])

  # Sum by fishery
  lik_by_fishery <- age_lik_data %>%
    group_by(fishery, scalar, scenario) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(Lik, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  # Add total
  lik_total <- lik_by_fishery %>%
    group_by(scalar, scenario) %>%
    summarise(value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(fishery = "Total")

  lik_combined <- bind_rows(lik_by_fishery, lik_total)

  lik_change <- lik_combined %>%
    group_by(fishery, scenario) %>%
    mutate(change = value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (nrow(lik_change) > 0) {
    print(create_piner_plot(lik_change, "fishery", "CAL"))
  } else {
    cat("*No shared CAL-by-fishery profile outputs were found.*\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Observation Fits: CPUE {.tabset}

## Observed vs Fitted CPUE by scenario {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r cpue-by-scenario, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis', fig.dim=c(8,8)}
# =============================================================================
# CPUE FITS BY SCENARIO
# Uses create_cpue_plots from plot_utils.R
# =============================================================================

# Prefer index fisheries when available; otherwise fallback to fisheries observed in CPUE objects.
cpue_fisheries <- pm_select_cpue_fisheries(RepOut_list, fishery_map)
cpue_mapping <- pm_build_fishery_mapping(fishery_map, cpue_fisheries)
cpue_overlay_info <- pm_overlay_capability(
  RepOut_list,
  extractor = function(x) as.numeric(unique(cpue_obs(x)$unit))
)

# Build long CPUE table for residual diagnostics (raw-scale residual: obs - fit).
cpue_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(RepOut_list, function(rep_obj, scenario_name) {
  obs <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(cpue_obs(rep_obj)), error = function(e) NULL)
  fit <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(cpue_pred(rep_obj)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(obs) || is.null(fit) || nrow(obs) == 0 || nrow(fit) == 0) return(NULL)

  names(obs)[names(obs) == "data"] <- "obs_log"
  names(fit)[names(fit) == "data"] <- "fit_log"

  cpue <- merge(obs, fit)
  cpue <- type.convert(cpue, as.is = TRUE)
  cpue <- cpue[cpue$unit %in% cpue_fisheries, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(cpue) == 0) return(NULL)

  cpue %>%
    mutate(
      unit_chr = as.character(unit),
      fishery_name = if_else(
        unit_chr %in% names(cpue_mapping),
        as.character(cpue_mapping[unit_chr]),
        paste("Unknown", unit_chr)
      ),
      year_season = year + (season - 1) / 4,
      obs = exp(obs_log),
      fit = exp(fit_log),
      residual = obs - fit,
      Scenario = scenario_name
    )
})

# Create plots using utility function
scenario_plots <- create_cpue_plots(
  RepOut_list = RepOut_list,
  fisheries = cpue_fisheries,

)

for (nm in names(scenario_plots)) {

  print(scenario_plots[[nm]])
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Observation Fits: Length Composition {.tabset}


## Composite Catch-at-Length by Fishery {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r composite_length_fit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Prepare length fit data from LengOut_list (composite over time)
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(LengOut_list)

# Extract and aggregate length.fit data for each model from LengOut_list
lfit_data_list <- list()

for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
  
  if(!is.null(LengOut_list[[model_name]])) {
    tryCatch({
      # Extract data from MFCLLenFit object - lenfits slot contains the time series data
      tmp_lfit <- LengOut_list[[model_name]]
      
      # Get the data.frame from lenfits slot
      lfit_df <- tmp_lfit@lenfits
      
      # Aggregate to composite (sum over years/months) - this matches length.fit.preparation() output
      # This creates the "totals" that appear at the bottom of length.fit file
      lfit_composite <- lfit_df %>%
        group_by(fishery, length) %>%
        summarise(
          obs = sum(obs * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),   # Weight by sample size
          pred = sum(pred * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE), # Weight by sample size
          .groups = "drop"
        )
      
      lfit_data_list[[model_name]] <- lfit_composite
      cat("Successfully loaded length.fit for", model_name, "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error extracting length.fit for", model_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else {
    cat("Warning: LengOut not available for", model_name, "\n")
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Get fisheries to plot
# =============================================================================

fisheries_to_plot <- fishery_map %>%
  filter(group != "Index") %>%
  pull(fishery) %>%
  unique()

# =============================================================================
# Create separate plot for each model
# =============================================================================

if(length(lfit_data_list) > 0) {
  
  for(model_name in names(lfit_data_list)) {
    
    cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
    
    lfit_model <- lfit_data_list[[model_name]]
    
    # Add fishery names
    pdat_model <- lfit_model %>%
      left_join(fishery_map[, c("fishery", "fishery_name")], by = "fishery") %>%
      filter(fishery %in% fisheries_to_plot)
    
    # Calculate bar width
    if(nrow(pdat_model) > 1) {
      bar_width <- unique(diff(sort(unique(pdat_model$length))))
      if(length(bar_width) == 0 || is.na(bar_width)) bar_width <- 2
    } else {
      bar_width <- 2
    }
    
    # Create plot
    p_model <- ggplot(pdat_model, aes(x = length)) +
      geom_bar(aes(y = obs), fill = "blue", colour = "blue", stat = "identity", width = bar_width, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pred), colour = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
      facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(
        x = "Length (cm)",
        y = "Samples",
        title = paste0("Composite Catch-at-Length Fit - ", model_name)
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
      )
    
    print(p_model)
    
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No length.fit data available.\n")
}


```

```{r lf-overlay, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(8,10), warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
# =============================================================================
# LENGTH FREQUENCY FITS - ALL SCENARIOS OVERLAID
# =============================================================================

# Get all unique fisheries
all_fisheries <- unique(unlist(lapply(LengOut_list, function(x) unique(x@lenfits$fishery))))

for (fish in all_fisheries) {
  fishery_name <- get_fishery_name(fish)
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", fishery_name))
  
  # Combine data from all scenarios
  combined_data <- map_dfr(names(LengOut_list), function(sc) {
    df <- LengOut_list[[sc]]@lenfits
    if (fish %in% unique(df$fishery)) {
      df %>% filter(fishery == fish) %>% mutate(Scenario = sc)
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
  
  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
    cat("*No data available for this fishery*\n\n")
    next
  }

  # Convert composition scale to sample-count scale when sample sizes are available.
  if ("sample_size" %in% names(combined_data)) {
    combined_data <- combined_data %>%
      mutate(
        obs = obs * sample_size,
        pred = pred * sample_size
      )
  }
  
  pred_data <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(Scenario, fishery, year, length) %>%
    summarise(pred = sum(pred), .groups = "drop")
  
  obs_data <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(fishery, year, length) %>%
    summarise(obs = sum(obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = obs_data, aes(x = length, y = obs, fill = "Observed"), alpha = 0.7, width = 2) +
    geom_line(data = pred_data, aes(x = length, y = pred, color = Scenario), linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~year, scales = "free_y", ncol = config$facet_ncol + 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("Observed" = "#E69F00")) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Scenario") +
    labs(title = paste(fishery_name, "- Length Frequency Fits"),
         x = "Length (cm)", y = "Sample count") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.box = "vertical",
          strip.text = element_text(size = 8))
  
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Composite Catch-at-Weight by Fishery  {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r composite_weight_fit, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Prepare weight fit data from WeightOut_list (composite over time)
# =============================================================================

# Check if WeightOut_list exists
if(exists("WeightOut_list")) {
  
  scenarios_name <- names(WeightOut_list)
  
  # Extract and aggregate weight.fit data for each model from WeightOut_list
  wfit_data_list <- list()
  
  for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
    
    if(!is.null(WeightOut_list[[model_name]])) {
      tryCatch({
        # Extract data from MFCLWgtFit object - similar structure to LenFit
        tmp_wfit <- WeightOut_list[[model_name]]
        
        # Get the data.frame from wgtfits slot (similar to lenfits)
        wfit_df <- tmp_wfit@wgtfits
        
        # Aggregate to composite (sum over years/months)
        wfit_composite <- wfit_df %>%
          group_by(fishery, weight) %>%
          summarise(
            obs = sum(obs * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE),   # Weight by sample size
            pred = sum(pred * sample_size, na.rm = TRUE), # Weight by sample size
            .groups = "drop"
          )
        
        wfit_data_list[[model_name]] <- wfit_composite
        cat("Successfully loaded weight.fit for", model_name, "\n")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Error extracting weight.fit for", model_name, ":", e$message, "\n")
      })
    } else {
      cat("Warning: WeightOut not available for", model_name, "\n")
    }
  }
  
  # =============================================================================
  # Get fisheries to plot
  # =============================================================================
  
  fisheries_to_plot <- fishery_map %>%
    filter(group != "Index") %>%
    pull(fishery) %>%
    unique()
  
  # =============================================================================
  # Create separate plot for each model
  # =============================================================================
  
  if(length(wfit_data_list) > 0) {
    
    for(model_name in names(wfit_data_list)) {
      
      cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
      
      wfit_model <- wfit_data_list[[model_name]]
      
      # Add fishery names
      pdat_model <- wfit_model %>%
        left_join(fishery_map[, c("fishery", "fishery_name")], by = "fishery") %>%
        filter(fishery %in% fisheries_to_plot)
      
      # Calculate bar width from the minimum positive bin spacing.
      if(nrow(pdat_model) > 1) {
        width_steps <- diff(sort(unique(pdat_model$weight)))
        width_steps <- width_steps[is.finite(width_steps) & width_steps > 0]
        bar_width <- if (length(width_steps) == 0) 0.5 else min(width_steps)
      } else {
        bar_width <- 0.5
      }
      
      # Create plot
      panel_count <- dplyr::n_distinct(pdat_model$fishery_name)
      border_lwd <- dplyr::case_when(
        panel_count >= 24 ~ 0.03,
        panel_count >= 12 ~ 0.06,
        TRUE ~ 0.12
      )
      p_model <- ggplot(pdat_model, aes(x = weight)) +
        geom_bar(aes(y = obs), fill = "blue", colour = "white", linewidth = border_lwd, stat = "identity", width = bar_width, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_line(aes(y = pred), colour = "red", linewidth = 1.2) +
        facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
        scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(
          x = "Weight (kg)",
          y = "Samples",
          title = paste0("Composite Catch-at-Weight Fit - ", model_name)
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
        )
      
      print(p_model)
      
    }
    
  } else {
    cat("No weight.fit data available.\n")
  }
  
} else {
  cat("WeightOut_list not found. Skipping weight composition plots.\n")
}
```
