# Tagging Dynamics {.tabset}

## Tag Reporting Rates by Group

```{r tag_reporting_rates, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.dim=c(10,12)}

# =============================================================================
# Extract tag reporting rate data from all scenarios
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(ParOut_list)

# Initialize list to store reporting rate data
tag_rr_list <- list()

# Build per-model reporting-group labels from model fishery maps
get_reporting_group_labels <- function(model_name) {
  fmap <- FISHERY_MAPS[[model_name]]
  if (is.null(fmap) || !is.data.frame(fmap)) {
    return(data.frame(group = numeric(0), group_name = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  by_recapture <- fmap %>%
    filter(!is.na(tag_recapture_group)) %>%
    mutate(
      group = as.numeric(tag_recapture_group),
      group_name = as.character(tag_recapture_name),
      fallback_name = as.character(fishery_name)
    ) %>%
    mutate(group_name = if_else(is.na(group_name) | !nzchar(group_name), fallback_name, group_name)) %>%
    select(group, group_name)

  by_fishery <- fmap %>%
    filter(!is.na(fishery), !is.na(fishery_name), nzchar(fishery_name)) %>%
    transmute(group = as.numeric(fishery), group_name = as.character(fishery_name))

  bind_rows(by_recapture, by_fishery) %>%
    filter(is.finite(group)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group_name), nzchar(group_name)) %>%
    arrange(group) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(group_name = first(group_name), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(group_name) %>%
    mutate(
      name_idx = row_number(),
      name_n = dplyr::n(),
      group_name = if_else(name_n > 1, paste0(group_name, "-", name_idx), group_name)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(group, group_name)
}

# Extract reporting rate data from each scenario
for (i in seq_along(ParOut_list)) {
  model_name <- scenarios_name[i]
  group_labels <- get_reporting_group_labels(model_name)
  
  # Extract upper bound for this scenario
  upper.bound <- subset(flags(ParOut_list[[i]]), flagtype == 1 & flag == 33)$value / 100
  
  # Extract tag reporting rate parameters
  tag_dt <- data.frame(
    group = c(tag_fish_rep_grp(ParOut_list[[i]])),
    rr = c(tag_fish_rep_rate(ParOut_list[[i]])),
    prior_mean = c(tag_fish_rep_target(ParOut_list[[i]]) / 100),
    prior_sd = c(sqrt(1 / (2 * tag_fish_rep_pen(ParOut_list[[i]]) )))
  ) %>%
    unique() %>%
    arrange(group) %>%
    left_join(group_labels, by = "group") %>%
    mutate(
      scenario = model_name,
      upper_bound = upper.bound,
      names = group_name
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(names), nzchar(names)) %>%
    select(-group_name)
  
  tag_rr_list[[model_name]] <- tag_dt
}

# Combine all scenarios
tag_rr_all <- bind_rows(tag_rr_list, .id = "Model")

# Generate prior distribution curves (normal distribution)
x_seq <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 500)
prior_curve_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(tag_rr_all)) {
  mean_val <- tag_rr_all$prior_mean[i]
  sd_val <- tag_rr_all$prior_sd[i]
  
  # Calculate normal distribution PDF
  pdf_vals <- dnorm(x_seq, mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val)
  
  prior_curve_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    Model = tag_rr_all$Model[i],
    group = tag_rr_all$group[i],
    names = tag_rr_all$names[i],
    x = x_seq,
    density = pdf_vals
  )
}

# Combine prior distribution curves
prior_curve <- bind_rows(prior_curve_list)
tag_rr_all <- tag_rr_all %>% mutate(panel = as.character(names))
prior_curve <- prior_curve %>% mutate(panel = as.character(names))

# Convert to factor for proper ordering
tag_rr_all$names <- factor(tag_rr_all$names, levels = unique(tag_rr_all$names))
tag_rr_all$Model <- factor(tag_rr_all$Model, levels = scenarios_name)
prior_curve$names <- factor(prior_curve$names, levels = levels(tag_rr_all$names))
prior_curve$Model <- factor(prior_curve$Model, levels = scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette
# =============================================================================

scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Create separate plots for each model
# =============================================================================

plot_list <- list()

for (model in scenarios_name) {
  
  # Filter data for this model
  tag_rr_model <- tag_rr_all %>% filter(Model == model)
  prior_curve_model <- prior_curve %>% filter(Model == model)
  
  # Create plot for this model
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Prior distribution curve (black line)
    geom_line(data = prior_curve_model, aes(x = x, y = density), 
              color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    # Estimated reporting rate (colored solid line)
    geom_vline(data = tag_rr_model, aes(xintercept = rr), 
               color = scenario_colors[model], linewidth = 1.5) +
    # Upper bound (blue dashed line)
    geom_vline(data = tag_rr_model, aes(xintercept = upper_bound), 
               color = "blue", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, NA)) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Tag group",
         y = "Density",
         title = paste("Tag Reporting Rates -", model)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  plot_list[[model]] <- p
}

# Print all plots
for (model in scenarios_name) {
  print(plot_list[[model]])
  cat("\n\n")
}

```

```{r tag_returns_by_recapture_group, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=14, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Define mixing period by model (in quarters)
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(TagTempOut_list)

# Resolve mixing period by model from model_info/config (no hardcoded default).
mixing_periods <- pm_get_mixing_periods(
  scenarios_name,

)

# =============================================================================
# Create model-specific tag recapture group mapping (excluding Index fisheries)
# =============================================================================

tag_recapture_map <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios_name, function(m) {
  pm_build_tag_recapture_map(FISHERY_MAPS[[m]], include_index = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(Model = m)
}))

# =============================================================================
# Process tag data from all models
# =============================================================================

tag_all <- pm_apply_mixing_filter(
  tag_temp_out_list = TagTempOut_list,
  mixing_periods = mixing_periods,
  seasons_per_model = seasons_per_model
)

# =============================================================================
# Add tag recapture group from fishery_map
# =============================================================================

tag_all <- tag_all %>%
  left_join(tag_recapture_map, by = c("Model", "recap.fishery" = "fishery"))

# =============================================================================
# Aggregate by model, tag recapture group, and time
# =============================================================================

tag_summary <- tag_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(tag_recapture_group)) %>%
  group_by(Model, tag_recapture_group, tag_recapture_name, recap_ts) %>%
  summarise(recap_obs = sum(recap.obs, na.rm = TRUE), recap_pred = sum(recap.pred, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# =============================================================================
# Pad time series to include all time steps
# =============================================================================

time_grid <- pm_pad_model_time(
  data = tag_summary,
  models = scenarios_name,
  seasons_per_model = seasons_per_model,
  time_col = "recap_ts",
  value_cols = c("recap_obs", "recap_pred")
)

all_groups <- unique(tag_summary$tag_recapture_group)
all_names <- tag_recapture_map %>% select(Model, tag_recapture_group, tag_recapture_name) %>% distinct()

tag_summary <- time_grid %>%
  dplyr::select(Model, recap_ts) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(tag_recapture_group = all_groups) %>%
  left_join(all_names, by = c("Model", "tag_recapture_group")) %>%
  left_join(tag_summary, by = c("Model", "tag_recapture_group", "tag_recapture_name", "recap_ts")) %>%
  mutate(
    recap_obs = replace_na(recap_obs, 0),
    recap_pred = replace_na(recap_pred, 0),
    Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name)
  )

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette
# =============================================================================

scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Create separate plot for each model
# =============================================================================

for (model_name in scenarios_name) {
  
  cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
  
  tag_summary_model <- tag_summary %>% filter(Model == model_name)
  
  p <- ggplot(tag_summary_model, aes(x = recap_ts)) +
    geom_point(aes(y = recap_obs), color = "red", fill = "red", na.rm = TRUE, size = 1, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21) +
    geom_line(aes(y = recap_pred), color = scenario_colors[model_name], na.rm = TRUE, linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ tag_recapture_name, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(x = "Time (year)", y = "Tag recaptures", title = paste0("Tag Returns Over Time - By Tag Recapture Group (", model_name, ")")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"), strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8))
  
  print(p)
  
}
```

## Fishery Selectivity

```{r selectivity_by_fishery, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}

# =============================================================================
# FISHERY SELECTIVITY (AGE/LENGTH/WEIGHT)
# This section represents fishery process dynamics.
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

sel_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  tmp_sel <- sel(tmp_rep)
  
  # Convert FLQuant to data frame using as.data.frame
  tmp_df <- as.data.frame(tmp_sel, drop = TRUE)
  
  # Rename columns and clean up
  tmp_df <- tmp_df %>%
    mutate(
      age = as.numeric(as.character(age)),
      fishery = as.numeric(as.character(unit)),
      selectivity = data,
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, fishery, age, selectivity)
  
  return(tmp_df)
})

sel_data <- bind_rows(sel_list)

# =============================================================================
# Add fishery names from fishery_map
# =============================================================================

fishery_map_by_model <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios_name, function(m) {
  FISHERY_MAPS[[m]][, c("fishery", "fishery_name", "group")] %>% mutate(Model = m)
}))

sel_data <- sel_data %>%
  left_join(fishery_map_by_model, by = c("Model", "fishery")) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette
# =============================================================================

scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Create age-based selectivity plot
# =============================================================================

p_age <- ggplot(sel_data, aes(x = age, y = selectivity, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Age class", y = "Selectivity", title = "Estimated Selectivity by Fishery (Age-based)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  )

print(p_age)




# =============================================================================
# Extract length-based selectivity data from all models
# =============================================================================

sel_len_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  
  # Get selectivity
  tmp_sel <- as.data.frame(sel(tmp_rep), drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      age = as.numeric(as.character(age)),
      fishery = as.numeric(as.character(unit)),
      selectivity = data
    ) %>%
    select(age, fishery, selectivity)
  
  # Get mean length at age - use aperm and convert to vector
  tmp_laa <- c(aperm(mean_laa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  
  # Add length based on age
  tmp_sel$length <- tmp_laa[tmp_sel$age]
  tmp_sel$Model <- model_name
  
  return(tmp_sel)
})

sel_len_data <- bind_rows(sel_len_list)

# =============================================================================
# Add fishery names from fishery_map
# =============================================================================

sel_len_data <- sel_len_data %>%
  left_join(fishery_map_by_model, by = c("Model", "fishery")) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Create length-based selectivity plot
# =============================================================================

p_length <- ggplot(sel_len_data, aes(x = length, y = selectivity, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ fishery_name, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(x = "Length (cm)", y = "Selectivity", title = "Estimated Selectivity by Fishery (Length-based)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
  )

print(p_length)




# =============================================================================
# Extract weight-based selectivity data from all models
# =============================================================================

sel_wt_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  
  # Get selectivity
  tmp_sel <- as.data.frame(sel(tmp_rep), drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      age = as.numeric(as.character(age)),
      fishery = as.numeric(as.character(unit)),
      selectivity = data
    ) %>%
    select(age, fishery, selectivity)
  
  # Get mean weight at age - use aperm and convert to vector
  tmp_waa <- c(aperm(mean_waa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  
  # Add weight based on age
  tmp_sel$weight <- tmp_waa[tmp_sel$age]
  tmp_sel$Model <- model_name
  
  return(tmp_sel)
})

sel_wt_data <- bind_rows(sel_wt_list)

# =============================================================================
# Add fishery names from fishery_map
# =============================================================================

sel_wt_data <- sel_wt_data %>%
```

## Regional Movement Matrix

```{r movement_matrix_by_quarter, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, results='asis'}

# =============================================================================
# Extract movement data from all models
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(ParOut_list)

# Create separate plot for each model
for(model_name in scenarios_name) {
  
  cat("\n\n### ", model_name, "\n\n")
  
  # Extract movement coefficients (returns an array)
  move_array <- diff_coffs_age_period(ParOut_list[[model_name]])
  
  # Convert array to data frame
  move_df <- as.data.frame.table(move_array, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(move_df) <- c("from", "to", "age", "period", "value")
  
  # Convert to numeric
  move_df <- move_df %>%
    mutate(
      from = as.numeric(from),
      to = as.numeric(to),
      age = as.numeric(age),
      period = as.numeric(period),
      value = as.numeric(value)
    )
  
  # Average across all ages for each quarter
  move_summary <- move_df %>%
    group_by(period, from, to) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Quarter = paste0("Quarter ", period))
  
  # Create heatmap
  p <- ggplot(move_summary, aes(x = to, y = from, fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ Quarter, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      "Diffusion\nCoefficient", 
      colors = c("royalblue3", "deepskyblue1", "gold", "orange1", "indianred1", "firebrick2", "#AC2020"),
      limits = c(0, NA)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(move_summary$to), labels = paste0("R", unique(move_summary$to))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = unique(move_summary$from), labels = paste0("R", unique(move_summary$from)), trans = "reverse") +
    labs(
      x = "From Region", 
      y = "To Region", 
      title = paste0("Estimated Regional Movement by Quarter (", model_name, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  
  print(p)
  
}
```

# Population Biology {.tabset}

## Stock-Recruitment Relationship

```{r srr_plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}

# =============================================================================
# Extract adult biomass and recruitment data
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

# Get adult biomass
adult_biomass_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  tmp_ab <- areaSums(adultBiomass(tmp_rep))
  tmp_df <- as.data.frame(tmp_ab, drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
      season = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
      sb = data,
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, year, season, sb)
  return(tmp_df)
})

adult_biomass <- bind_rows(adult_biomass_list)

# Get recruitment
recruitment_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  tmp_rec <- areaSums(popN(tmp_rep)[1,])
  tmp_df <- as.data.frame(tmp_rec, drop = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      year = as.numeric(as.character(year)),
      season = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
      rec = data,
      Model = model_name
    ) %>%
    select(Model, year, season, rec)
  return(tmp_df)
})

recruitment <- bind_rows(recruitment_list)

# Merge adult biomass and recruitment
srr_data_seasonal <- adult_biomass %>%
  left_join(recruitment, by = c("Model", "year", "season"))

# Aggregate to annual (mean SB, sum recruitment)
srr_data <- srr_data_seasonal %>%
  group_by(Model, year) %>%
  summarise(
    sb = mean(sb, na.rm = TRUE),
    rec = sum(rec, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Get Beverton-Holt parameters and create fitted curve
# =============================================================================

bh_list <- lapply(names(RepOut_list), function(model_name) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[model_name]]
  bh_params <- srr(tmp_rep)
  
  # Get max sb for this specific model
  model_data <- srr_data %>% filter(Model == model_name)
  max_sb_model <- max(model_data$sb, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  sb_seq <- seq(0, max_sb_model, length = 100)
  
  # Extract parameters as vectors using c()
  a_val <- c(bh_params$a)
  b_val <- c(bh_params$b)
  
  bh_df <- data.frame(
    sb = sb_seq,
    rec = (sb_seq * a_val) / (b_val + sb_seq),
    Model = model_name
  )
  return(bh_df)
})

bh_data <- bind_rows(bh_list) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Define units for scaling
# =============================================================================

sb_units <- 1000
rec_units <- 1000000

# =============================================================================
# Create SRR plot by model with year as color
# =============================================================================

p_srr <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = bh_data, aes(x = sb/sb_units, y = rec/rec_units), color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = srr_data, aes(x = sb/sb_units, y = rec/rec_units, fill = year), shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Model, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Year", option = "viridis") +
  ylim(c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("Adult biomass (mt; ", format(sb_units, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "s)"),
    y = paste0("Recruitment (N; ", format(rec_units, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE), "s)"),
    title = "Stock-Recruitment Relationship by Model (Annual)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

print(p_srr)


```

## Growth Curve

```{r growth_plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=10}

# =============================================================================
# Extract growth data from all models
# =============================================================================

scenarios_name <- names(RepOut_list)

growth_list <- lapply(seq_along(RepOut_list), function(i) {
  tmp_rep <- RepOut_list[[i]]
  model_name <- names(RepOut_list)[i]
  
  # Get mean length at age and SD
  tmp_laa <- c(aperm(mean_laa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  tmp_sd_laa <- c(aperm(sd_laa(tmp_rep), c(4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6)))
  
  # For a single-model report, show an approximate 95% band from mean_laa +/- 1.96*sd_laa.
  # This is model-predicted spread at age, not parameter-estimation uncertainty.
  if(length(RepOut_list) == 1) {
    tmp_lower <- tmp_laa - 1.96 * tmp_sd_laa
    tmp_upper <- tmp_laa + 1.96 * tmp_sd_laa
  } else {
    tmp_lower <- tmp_laa
    tmp_upper <- tmp_laa
  }
  
  growth_df <- data.frame(
    Model = model_name,
    age = 1:length(tmp_laa),
    length = tmp_laa,
    lower = tmp_lower,
    upper = tmp_upper
  )
  
  return(growth_df)
})

growth_data <- bind_rows(growth_list) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = scenarios_name))

# =============================================================================
# Define color palette
# =============================================================================

scenario_colors <- get_scenario_colors(scenarios_name)

# =============================================================================
# Create growth plot
# =============================================================================

p_growth <- ggplot(growth_data, aes(x = age, y = length, color = Model, fill = Model)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual("Model", values = scenario_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Age class",
    y = "Length (cm)",
    title = "Model Growth Curve",
    subtitle = if (length(RepOut_list) == 1) {
      "Band = mean_laa +/- 1.96 * sd_laa (model-predicted L-at-age spread)"
    } else {
      "Multiple models: uncertainty band suppressed"
    }
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "gray85"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_growth)

```
